subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should this PR require redacted real remote/slow Ollama proof before merge, or may maintainers accept regression-test-only evidence for this timeout-refresh change?
rationale: The source fix matches the guarded-fetch contract, but the user-facing failure is environment-dependent and the PR changes provider timeout semantics for existing configurations.

options.title: Require remote Ollama proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing an OpenClaw Ollama chat or infer run completing against a remote or slow host after this patch.

options.title: Accept test-only timeout parity
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept that native Ollama streams should match sibling transports by treating `timeoutSeconds` as an idle timeout while chunks arrive.

recommendation.title: Require remote Ollama proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a short recording showing an OpenClaw Ollama chat or infer run completing against a remote or slow host after this patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama stream work makes this the best available routing candidate for the provider-specific timeout behavior.
